trigger: 绑定一个目标API调用 when its declared inputs are available.

inputs.name: target_version
inputs.description: Object with required keys `host`, `spaceclaim_release`, `api_version`, and `runtime` for the exact requested target.

inputs.name: operation_semantics
inputs.description: Object with required keys `operation_id`, `inputs`, `outputs`, `side_effects`, and `units` for one operation semantic.

inputs.name: known_api_signature
inputs.description: Object with required keys `symbol`, `arguments`, `return_type`, `version`, and `source_ref`; the signature must be supplied and source-backed.

preconditions: 目标API资料或实测依据可用
Use only this single-action procedure; source or upstream instance references must be supplied.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: One 版本化调用绑定 in the common envelope; data fields: api_binding, compatibility_notes.

postconditions: 参数及返回值类型与指定版本匹配；未知兼容性保留
The typed result and provenance agree with the declared single-action scope; unsupported required fields withhold a resolved result.

implementation.target_environment: Source interpretation or strategy reasoning; no SpaceClaim runtime.
implementation.notes: No standalone deterministic interpreter is claimed. Apply only MS-05 in the hash-bound guidance reference using atomic-reasoning-protocol.md.

ambiguity_checks: Reject a missing, version-mismatched, or untraceable API signature.
Never invent a symbol, argument order, overload, return type, or compatibility claim from a generic API name.
Do not present a planning binding as proof of SpaceClaim execution or runtime compatibility.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: No geometry handles are acquired; declarations do not mutate or refresh application topology.

failure_modes.condition: The declared action inputs cannot support a unique required result.
failure_modes.detection: Apply the action rejection rules and inspect raw source evidence.
failure_modes.safe_state: Return actionable unresolved fields; retain original evidence and values.

recovery.action: Supply only the missing source or prerequisite, then repeat this action; do not invent geometry or start application execution.

validation.method: Inspect named inputs, result fields, procedure and rejection rules for MS-05
validate_atomic_reasoning.py with an actual source manifest; separately review interpretation against raw material.
validation.expected: 参数及返回值类型与指定版本匹配；未知兼容性保留

host_checked.notes: Host structure/invariants and bounded independent source evaluation; no automatic promotion.

evidence_level.notes: Candidate. Structural tests cannot establish source interpretation accuracy or any SpaceClaim runtime capability.
